$comment: The one place the trip planner's character lives. The brain (backend/persona.py) and the page (frontend/src/persona.ts) both read this file. To change the character: change `character` (an avatar character id; the idle dock's still photo is frontend/src/characters/<character>.webp), `name`, and each language's `voice`. `roles` is the dock's label per page (`role` when a page has none). Languages: only the ones listed are offered; with one, the page shows no language toggle and the brain has no language switch. To add a language: add an entry under `languages` (BCP-47 tag) with its label, voice, greeting and the toggle's confirm line; the brain's written lines for Hindi already exist (backend/lead.py, backend/brain.py), another language needs its own. A voice must speak the language it is listed under (see GET https://app.voqalize.com/api/v1/catalog.get).
